name: Arcane Eye
description:
Concentration, up to 1 hour.

You create an invisible magical sensor at a point you choose within short range. The sensor hovers in the air, has the same vision as you, and can look in every direction. You see through the sensor in addition to your own natural sight.

You may spend an action to move the sensor up to short range from its current location in any direction. The sensor cannot pass through openings smaller than 1 inch in diameter.

Describe how you experience this sense.

improvements.name: Arcane Ear
improvements.description: You may spend an additional 2 MP when you cast the spell to add the sense of hearing to the sensor.

improvements.name: Clairvoyance
improvements.description: You may create the sensor at a point within 1 mile from you in a location you have visited or seen before, or in an obvious unfamiliar location (like behind a hedge or on the other side of a door).
